1.text: Wisdom. In this book, Wisdom is taken for the Deity, the Son, or the gift communicated to men. Prov. iii. 19. Wisd. vii. 25. C.

3.text: God. This is eternal and unsearchable, more than the sand of the sea, &c. Is. xl. 12. H. --- Man cannot comprehend God's works. W.

4.text: Created. Or "generated," if it be understood of the Son. S. Athan. Bos. --- The wisdom which is given to man, was in God before the creation. Prov. viii. 22. C. --- The decree regarding the incarnation was from eternity. M.

5.text: Commandments. The wise will observe the law (Deut. iv. 6. H.) and the Scriptures. This verse is not in the Gr. of Rome, &c. but it is in the edit. of Complut. and Camerarius.

9.text: In the Holy Ghost, or from himself. See Wisd. i. 5. and vii. 22. Gr. omits these words. C.

11.text: Joy. Eternal glory is the fruit of the fear of the Lord; not that this virtue sufficeth, but it is the beginning, grounded on true faith, and bringeth forth other virtues, and fruits of the Holy Ghost, and a joyful crown in the end. W. --- The virtuous enjoy or deserve honour. C.

16.text: Womb. Grace has prevented them. H. --- They are free from evil dispositions. Wisd. viii. 19. Job xxxi. 18. --- Women; feminis, or rather seminis. C. --- Gr. "it shall be intrusted to their seed." H. --- "His mercy is fixed with their seed." Syr. M. --- This includes both men and women.

17.text: Religiousness, or proper application of knowledge. H. --- A learned impious man is most dangerous. This and the two next verses are not in Greek.

27.text: Sin, by vigilance or by repentance.

29.text: To him, as may be seen in the lives of the patriarchs.

32.text: Sinner. Such imagine that God's service is insupportable. W.

35.text: Faith, or fidelity. M. --- The meek shall possess the land. Matt. v. 4. C.

39.text: Down. Pride is usually thus treated. Matt. xxiii. 12. C.
